name: retrieval_coverage
description: Judge which sub-questions each retrieved passage answers.

questions.none_option: None of the sub-questions is answered

instructions.title: Does the passage answer the question?
instructions.summary: Read a retrieved passage and mark which sub-questions it answers.
instructions.background: A complex question was split into sub-questions. A search system retrieved passages for the original question. We want to know if each passage contains the information needed to answer specific sub-questions.
definitions: One part of the original question.
The passage explicitly states the fact or provides the direct evidence needed to answer the sub-question. Mentioning the topic without giving the answer does not count.
howto: Read the original question and the list of sub-questions on the right.
Read the passage on the left carefully.
Tick every sub-question that the passage fully answers.
If the passage answers none of them, select 'None of the sub-questions is answered'.
Do not use outside knowledge; judge only based on the text provided.
instructions.tip: If you had to write an answer to a sub-question using ONLY this passage, could you do it? If yes, tick it.
